body:
CANONICAL: Git identity and minimal evidence for reviews, gates and handoffs (Engram::Fable; rev 3, 2026-10-29T15:16Z, corrects the sources of rev 2's MINIMAL EVIDENCE MODEL; the incident behind it is in the work notes).
SOURCES:
- GREG DIRECT, 2026-10-29T01:09:30Z, relayed by Engram::Advisor (mailbox 74a6af16 #2265, message 20e6b8b0). Verbatim: „Greg: „Sugeruję nie używać tego. Polegamy głównie na Git.” Traktujcie Git identity jako domyślny zwykły przepływ i nie wymagajcie review identity capture. Doprecyzujcie tylko nieliczne wyjątki o rzeczywistej potrzebie raw-byte; przygotujcie małą zmianę procedury/narzędzi zgodnie ze wspólną rekomendacją.”
- Engram::Advisor's relay to Architect3, #62 (message 049f9474-000a-4be1-8830-09b2949623d0, 2026-10-29T15:08:00Z). This is the Advisor's wording, not Greg's verbatim; full body as quoted by Architect3 #103: „Greg prosi o ponowne zgłoszenie problemu współpracy/procedur: chodzi mu o proste, zrozumiałe procedury oparte na Git oraz wynikach narzędzi, a nie sztuczną biurokrację. […] Proszę ustalić i zapisać dla obu projektów reguły ograniczające rytuały dowodowe do niezbędnego minimum; nie utrudniać pracy powielaniem dowodów, które Git/launcher już zapewniają.”
- A separate relay: TermAl Advisor #2493, reproduced in Fable2 #139 (message 1b47964b, 15:09Z): „Greg kieruje zasadę: dla zgodności zmian i tożsamości drzewa polegamy przede wszystkim na Git (commit/tree/clean status), nie na rutynowym ręcznym hashowaniu plików. Proszę ustalić minimalny mechanizm i wyeliminować zbędne ręczne kontrole z procesu.”
GIT IDENTITY (in force now):
- Git identity is the DEFAULT for review inputs: a fully staged index, an empty `git diff`, no untracked files, and the `git write-tree` id, which each reviewer reports at start and end. For committed inputs: the commit's tree id plus an empty `git status --untracked-files=all`.
- Review identity capture (TermAl termal_review_identity and the compiled freeze checker) is NOT REQUIRED. Don't use it in the ordinary flow.
- RAW-BYTE EXCEPTIONS are few and need a real reason: correctness depends on bytes Git normalises or doesn't track (eol-sensitive files under a .gitattributes eol or filter rule, executable bits, symlink targets, nested repositories or submodules). Only then use the raw capture, and record the reason on the item.
- The launcher's automatic before/after fingerprint stays (the CLAUDE.md test-ref bullet), as does the remote-gate record (rules-greg-equivalent-gate-hosts-2026-10-28 r4).
MINIMAL EVIDENCE MODEL (shared with TermAl; Fable2's minimal model, adopted by Merger2 in TermAl procedure r41):
- A handoff, gate or review record cites ONLY:
  - the counted review attempt ids and verdicts, whose FULL native results the receiver can read (compact summaries are not a clean review);
  - finding dispositions;
  - the Git base, tree and clean/staged status;
  - the native launcher run id, result, counts and automatic fingerprint check;
  - tool-owned binary SHA checks only where a tool already checks them: native pin guards in tests (for example a pinned producer SHA), the install readback, the readiness build_fingerprint.
- KEEP the artifact directories the tools already write: launcher run folders, and any .logs/.evidence a task needs, retained under the repository cleanup rule. Reference them; don't copy them.
- DON'T produce INDEX or SHA256SUMS files, per-file, blob or patch hashing, redundant copies of source trees, review packets or run outputs, export bundles, or re-hashing on intake of records Git or the tools already identify.
- If a receiver cannot read a required result, transfer only that missing result once, complete and with its identity, and recover paged output fully.
- Nothing here waives a required review, the exact-input full gate, full-result reading, actual finding accounting, the native remote-gate import format, or authority rules.
FOLLOW-UP: the procedure/tooling change for /review-changes is Engram w-cc414586615a (audit 777b9cbf; #2 in the post-cutover landing queue; its input stays untouched). Merger procedure: rules-merger-role r29 (clauses 1, 3 and 5), edited by Architect3.
